description: A huge reptile with a long head and a heavy body, seen from the side and slightly front, facing to the right, its head low and close to the viewer. Its scaly hide is speckled grey, brown and green, with a row of green spiky crests along its back and above its eye. A clawed foreleg stands at the lower left. The background is pure black, so the creature seems to lunge out of darkness; the mood is predatory and cold. Frame 1: the jaws gape wide, showing a red mouth lined with white fangs. Frame 2: the jaws close tight, teeth showing along the lips, the head lifted slightly. The open mouth flashes briefly and the shut jaws hold three times as long, so the loop reads as a sudden snap followed by a long, watchful pause.
title: Giant lizard snapping its jaws
